column1: # Native version vectors shared by the Rust unit tests (src/family/version_tests.rs)
# deb          version         version         < = >    dpkg version ordering
# deb-invalid  version         -               error    dpkg refuses the version
# deb-strict   version         -               error    dpkg only warns; Pakomichi refuses
# rpm          segment         segment         < = >    rpmvercmp on one version field
# rpm-overlap  OP EVR          OP EVR          1 0      Provides (left) vs Requires (right)
# dpkg: Debian Policy 5.6.12 and dpkg lib/dpkg/t/t-version.c
